title: Esztergom Basilica
visualBrief: Individual Esztergom Basilica: eight-column classical open portico/triangular pediment/inset timber portal, broad pale rectangular masonry body with paired round windows/high lunettes and rear parapet terrace. Two lateral tower wings with genuine round arch passages and balustrades, octagonal dark-louvered upper stages/green domes/crosses. Dominant tall pale colonnaded central drum, recessed rectangular window bays, heavy circular cornice and green ribbed copper dome/orb/cross. Four existing shared stone/continuous limestone/copper/wood graphs, metric UVs, linear tints and four browser levels. Fine Corinthian sculpture/reliefs/inscriptions, interiors and exact hilltop threshold joins remain approximate or excluded.
